title: A nonlocal Busenberg-Travis cross-diffusion system with nonlinear Brinkman law
summary: A nonlocal Busenberg-Travis cross-diffusion system for segregating populations is analyzed in a bounded domain with no-flux boundary conditions. The velocities of the species solve a regularized Darcy law, which can be interpreted as a Brinkman equation. Compared to results in the literature, the density-pressure relation is assumed to be nonlinear. The global existence of weak solutions to this system is shown for a broad range of the exponents of the power-law nonlinearity, and the localization limit is proved.
